title: Hussain chup hain
body:
Hussein chup hai
Hussein chup hai
Ya Hussein, Haaye Hussein
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Khuda Ki Marzi, Mai Sar Jhukaakar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Ye Sabr Ki Kounsi Hai Manzil, Pisar Ka Barchhi Se Chhidgaya Dil, Woh Hass Rahaa Hai Sirhaane Qaatil, Ya Hussein, Uthaaye Haatho Pe Laashe Akber, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kharaa Hai Laakhon Mai Woh Akela, Chalaaye Jaate Hai Teer Aadaa, Kahin Se Barchhi Kahin Se Bhaala, Ya Hussein, Baras Rahe Hai Kahin Se Pathhar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Lagaa Hai Kyun Mere Dil Ko Dharkaa, Lahu Se Kiske Yeh Tar Hai Chehra, Kahaan Hai Asgher Bataaye Maula, Ya Hussein, Sawaal Asgher Ki Maa Ka Sunkar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Naseeb-e-Raahib Jo Shehne Badlaa, Wahaan Pe Khaamosh Kibriyaa Tha, Magar Yeh Manzar Hai Karbala Ka, Ya Hussein, Yahaan Pe Dekar Khuda Ko Akber, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Kahaa Ye Qaasid Ne Roke Maula, Mareez Beti Ka Khat Hun Laaya, Salaam Sabko Hai Ussne Likha, Ya Hussein, Salaam Ka Bas, Jawaab De Kar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Huwe Hai Zakhmon Se Chur Maula, Badan Se Behta Hai Khun Ka Dariya, Kahe To Rakhdu Ulatke Duniya, Ya Hussein, Madad Ko Aaya, Hai Ran Mai Zaafar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ladhi Akele Mai Woh Ladhaayi, Duhaai Dene Lagi Khudaayi, Sadaa Juhi Irjaee Ki Aayi, Ya Hussein, Neyaam Mai, Zulfiqar Rakh Kar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Hussein Gohar Yeh Jaanta Hai, Safar Ye Chouda-So Saal Ka Hai, Sitam Jo Ab Tak Woh Seh Raha Hai, Ya Hussein, Laraaz Iss Mai Koi Toh Akber, Hussein Chup Hai
<<MINI>>
Ya Ghareeb Imam, Ya Ghareeb Ya Hussein
Ujargaya Hai Batul Ka Ghar, Hussein Chup Hai
